requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3179-3249-3755--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3179-3249-3755--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Oketra's Monument triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

645-804-1267-6495.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-804-1267-6495.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Sakashima the Impostor.
Sakashima the Impostor triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Sakashima the Impostor
Repeat each turn.

1981-2415-5231-6772.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature, adding {R}
When the creature dies, Syr Vondam and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

252-969-4231-5394.easyPrerequisites:
You control another artifact creature.
You have a way to kill the additional artifact creature.
252-969-4231-5394.description:
Cause another artifact creature you control to die.
When the artifact creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
As the Clue, Food and Treasure enter, they each become 7/7 Dinosaur artifact creatures in addition to their other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

1594-1895-2781-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1253-4091-7791.description:
Activate Gyre Engineer by tapping it, adding {G}{U}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Gyre Engineer.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Gyre Engineer.
Repeat.

215-5709-7296.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Forests.
215-5709-7296.description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Rofellos from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Rofellos by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2438-3054-5346-6809.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Crime Novelist and Scion of Opulence trigger.
Resolve the Crime Novelist trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Scion of Opulence trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6822-7693.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
3532-5078-6822-7693.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

573-1308-1558-3875-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
573-1308-1558-3875-4231.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Anointed Procession.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

147-5231-7335.easyPrerequisites: There is a valid target for Pain 101 on the battlefield.
147-5231-7335.description:
Cast Pain 101 by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Pain 101, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Pain 101.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

465-2438-4605-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {3}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Wormfang Drake and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Wormfang Drake.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1475-5147-7084.notablePrerequisites: You control another nonland creature with power 1 or greater that does not have One with the Kami attached to it.
1475-5147-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature you control with power 1 or greater.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and One with the Kami trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the land's power.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2034-4871-5795-5998-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Barkform Harvester by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Repeat.

1482-2099-2866-4986.description:
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

1680-4508-5880-6291.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token and a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1322-2457-3000-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

232-4790-6753.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Priest of Urabrask that are 6/6 Dinosaurs.
When the Priest of Urabrask tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding six {R}.
Repeat.

1879-2457-4289-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1902-3750.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four other Elves.
Wirewood Channeler does not have summoning sickness.
1902-3750.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler  by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
1902-3750.notes: The infinite mana result requires you to control at least six total Elves.

97-575-897.description:
Activate Ravenous Baloth by sacrificing Branchsnap Lorian.
When Branchsnap Lorian dies, Yedora triggers, returning Branchsnap Lorian from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Ravenous Baloth ability, causing you to gain 4 life.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Branchsnap Lorian's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

151-1719-5261.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
Vizier of Tumbling Sands does not have summoning sickness.
151-1719-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of To Arms! without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of To Arms!, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets near-infinite mana.

2743-5693.description:
Cast Aggressive Biomancy by paying {6}{G}{U}, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
When the Biovisionary tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger - choose not to fight another creature.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

914-2438-5128.notablePrerequisites:
Dockside Extortionist has a sticker on it.
Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2438-5128.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Activate Scampire by paying {3}{B}, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}.
Repeat.

141-190-4735.description:
Cast Crafty Cutpurse by paying {3}{U}.
Crafty Cutpurse enters the battlefield, causing all tokens that would be created under an opponent's control this turn to be created under you control instead.
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, targeting any permanent.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Naru Meha enters the battlefield, creating a copy of Fractured Identity, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Fractured Identity, exiling Naru Meha and creating a copy of Naru Meha for each opponent you have.
Put all but one Naru Meha token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Naru Meha token(s) enter the battlefield, creating a copy of Fractured Identity targeting Naru Meha, and any other instants and/or sorceries on the stack.
Repeat from step 6.
You may also have the additional triggers target permanents your opponent control to exile them and create token copies of them.

991-2120-2334.notablePrerequisites:
Wanderwine Prophets does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
You control at least one additional Merfolk.
991-2120-2334.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Wanderwine Prophets.
Wanderwine Prophets triggers, causing you to sacrifice a Merfolk to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beggining of the end step, Soulherder's second ability triggers, blinking Benthicore.
Soulherder's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Benthicore enters the battlefield, creating two 1/1 Merfolk Wizard creature tokens.
Repeat.
